title: BLES01658 Dragon Ball Z Budokai HD Collection

core.abMode: 561 early submission alternating per profiling window (~5 s), on first; COREPROF OPT561 early_submit gives each window state

source: user-supplied RPCS3 performance (current and rotated), diagnostic, milestones and app logs, 2026-10-27
method: Combat windows (>=170 draws/frame, no frame over 60 ms): each lever-on window against the mean of its two lever-off neighbours, so scene drift and device state cancel. Windows 43 and 45 excluded (226 ms and 77 ms stalls).

light.note: Too few pairs to conclude; no sign of a regression.

finding: Combat: the lever is faster in 12 of 12 paired windows: +1.8 FPS median (+1.1 to +2.3), frame time -0.9 ms (-4%), p95 -0.7 ms; p99 and 1% low unchanged within noise.
Mechanism confirmed: readback wait -1.7 ms per frame and frame latency -1.65 ms per frame with ~2 early submissions per frame.
The 562 slowdown was session conditions: lever-off combat runs at 43.7 FPS here (562 session: 35.4; 560 session: 41.7).
interpretation: The 561 lever is a small, consistent gain on DBZ combat, measured under identical conditions. Keeping it on (no alternation) is supported by this evidence.
gainScope: DBZ BLES01658 combat, this device and session
